description.en: Pipeline is a lead and call center CRM for property agents, insurance teams, and telesales: sort new leads by interest, schedule follow-ups, handle calls from a live call panel, and move every lead through the pipeline.
description.id: Pipeline adalah CRM lead dan call center untuk agen properti, tim asuransi, dan telesales: saring lead baru berdasarkan minat, jadwalkan follow-up, tangani panggilan dari panel panggilan langsung, dan gerakkan setiap lead di pipeline.
